📺 Gauntlet. Nadia and Liam have been taken.

Three gates. Three waves. No rest between. The System: "WAVE ONE. TRY TO LOOK SURPRISED."

The crowd chants Nadia and Liam's name. Wrong. Every time, wrong.

📺 Gauntlet — wave two. Bigger. It has seen the first wave's corpse and learned nothing, which is worse.

Nadia and Liam's arms are heavy. The System's overlay helpfully displays the damage so far in numbers the size of weather — it wants everyone to know. The closer is watching the numbers too.

📺 Gauntlet — wave three. What comes out of the gate is wrong in ways the first two weren't.

The closer smells blood. The whole galaxy leans in. Almost nobody walks away from this one.
